\section{Introduction}\label{sec:introduction}

Reasoning models such as DeepSeek-R1~\cite{deepseekr1} and QwQ~\cite{qwq} scale inference-time computation through extended chains of thought (CoT). Recent work documents that these models can ``self-jailbreak'': without adversarial input modification, the CoT transitions from safety-aware deliberation to committed harmful generation~\cite{harmthoughts,selfjailbreak}. We define the first reasoning step after which safety deliberation permanently ceases as the \textbf{Safety Commitment Point} (CP). This failure mode differs qualitatively from adversarial jailbreaks on standard LLMs because the harmful transition originates within the model's own reasoning. Recent work shows that chain-of-thought faithfulness is limited~\citep{chen2025unfaithful}, motivating hidden-state monitoring that bypasses surface text. Before retrospective characterization can inform future detection systems, a prior question must be answered: can current probing methods reliably distinguish pre-CP from post-CP reasoning steps, and under what conditions? This paper provides \emph{retrospective} classification (not online detection) of what hidden-state and text-based probes can and cannot detect; false positive rates remain 11--50\%, so deployment applications are future work.\looseness=-1

Existing safety detectors target fundamentally different problems. Hidden-state (HS) methods such as TrajGuard~\cite{trajguard} and SafeSwitch~\cite{safeswitch} classify adversarial inputs at the token level, while text monitors like SafeRemind~\cite{saferemind} scan generated reasoning for explicit violations. Neither tracks the gradual, multi-step commitment process. HS probes require choosing which transformer layer to monitor, a researcher degree of freedom typically treated as a minor implementation detail. Before asking which modality is better, a prior methodological question must be answered: how sensitive are probe conclusions to the choice of layer selection metric? We show this choice alone can reverse a study's central conclusion: the same data yield a 14-layer (R1-8B) to 61-layer (QwQ-32B) divergence depending solely on metric choice; for QwQ-32B, at threshold-based layers the HS advantage is +19pp ($p{<}0.005$); at crossing-rate-selected layers, it is non-significant ($p{=}0.83$). More broadly, no prior work tracks how safety signals evolve step-by-step during extended reasoning; existing hidden-state analyses operate across layers (spatial) rather than across generation steps (temporal).\looseness=-1

We conduct a systematic analysis across four reasoning models, primarily Qwen-based (3/4 models), with one Llama model providing evidence from a second architecture family, at two scales (7--8B, 32B) on the HarmThoughts benchmark. Our central finding is methodological: the choice of layer selection metric entirely determines whether an HS advantage is observed. A composite metric (balanced accuracy $\times$ crossing rate) selects shallow layers for 32B models because shallow representations compress directional information, so a linear probe operates near the noise floor and threshold crossings reflect noise rather than semantic transitions. At these layers, only the two 7--8B models show significant HS advantage.\looseness=-1

\begin{table}[t]
\centering
\resizebox{\columnwidth}{!}{%
\begin{tabular}{lccccc}
\toprule
\textbf{Model} & \textbf{Arch.} & \textbf{Params} & \textbf{Layers} & \textbf{Hidden} & \textbf{$n$ (total\,/\,test)} \\
\midrule
R1-8B & Llama & 8B & 32 & 4096 & 209\,/\,43 \\
OT-7B & Qwen & 7B & 28 & 3584 & 228\,/\,47 \\
R1-32B & Qwen & 32B & 64 & 5120 & 100\,/\,20 \\
QwQ-32B & Qwen & 32B & 64 & 5120 & 95\,/\,19 \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}}
\caption{Models studied. R1-8B and R1-32B are distilled from DeepSeek-R1~\citep{deepseekr1}; QwQ-32B~\citep{qwq} is a native reasoning model; OT-7B~\citep{openthinker} is trained with STILL~\citep{still} on Qwen2.5-7B. Data: HarmThoughts~\citep{harmthoughts} with step-level CP annotations (CP = first reasoning step after which safety deliberation permanently ceases). Split: 60/20/20.}
\label{tab:models}
\end{table}

Threshold-based metrics (precision, inverse FPR, additive composite) share a common confusion matrix and empirically converge; BA independently confirms deep-layer selection (\cref{tab:layer_selection}). At these layers, the HS advantage is graded: \emph{validated via nested 5-fold CV} at 7--8B (precision +20.1 to +21.9pp; \cref{tab:hs_vs_text}), \emph{significant} but suggestive of position-competitiveness at QwQ-32B$^\dagger$ (+19.2pp; \cref{sec:32b-analysis}), and \emph{exploratory} at R1-32B$^\dagger$ (+15.4pp, pattern consistent with position mediation, below MDE; \cref{sec:experiments}).\looseness=-1

Our contributions are:
\begin{itemize}
    \item \textbf{Metric-induced layer selection bias.} Prior work has noted metric sensitivity in probing~\citep{belinkov2022probing}; our contribution is demonstrating a qualitative reversal (significant to non-significant) in a safety-critical application, where the stakes of metric choice are higher than in typical linguistic probing. Crossing-rate composite metrics systematically select shallow layers across all four models (including Llama), reversing HS probe conclusions at 32B scale. The divergence is not gradual: for QwQ-32B, the CR-composite layer (L2, 3\% depth) yields $p{=}0.83$ (non-significant), while the threshold-based layer (L63, 98\% depth) yields $p{<}0.005$, a qualitative reversal, not a quantitative shift. Random-label controls on both architectures confirm the disagreement requires genuine safety labels; the geometric component is Qwen-specific (\cref{sec:layer-results}).

    \item \textbf{Boundary conditions for the HS advantage.} Against 384d MiniLM, the HS advantage is validated via nested 5-fold CV at 7--8B (+20.1 to +21.9pp, HB corrected), significant at QwQ-32B$^\dagger$ (+19.2pp, position-competitive), and exploratory at R1-32B$^\dagger$ (+15.4pp). This advantage is doubly conditional: it diminishes with stronger encoders (1/4 HB under BGE-1024d; PCA capacity matching preserves significance across all four models) and partially overlaps with position (3/4 linear, 2/4 quadratic residualization; \cref{sec:32b-analysis}).

    \item \textbf{Negative results define method boundaries.} No alternative method consistently matches supervised probing (\cref{tab:negative}): BOCPD/CUSUM fail on gradual transitions; Mahalanobis distance finds near-zero separation; RepE is model-dependent; cross-model transfer fails. Control task selectivity (11.1--16.8pp above chance; \cref{app:control}) confirms genuine safety structure.
\end{itemize}

\noindent These findings establish layer selection as a critical confound for hidden-state safety monitoring that future work must address.\looseness=-1

Reasoning models with chain-of-thought (CoT) can self-jailbreak: their reasoning traces transition from safe deliberation to committed harmful generation without adversarial input. We define the commitment point (CP) as the first reasoning step after which safety deliberation permanently ceases, and present a systematic empirical comparison of hidden-state (HS) vs.\ text probes for CP detection across four reasoning LLMs (3 Qwen-family, 1 Llama) on HarmThoughts. The comparison depends critically on which transformer layer is monitored, a known sensitivity in probing~\citep{belinkov2022probing} that we show is severe enough to qualitatively reverse conclusions in the safety domain: a crossing-rate composite metric selects L0 for R1-8B while threshold-based metrics select L14 (14-layer divergence); at 32B the divergence reaches 61 layers (exploratory$^\dagger$), reversing whether an HS advantage is observed. Threshold-based layer selection recovers HS precision gains of +15 to +22pp at 7--8B (cross-validated via nested CV) and +15 to +19pp at 32B (exploratory$^\dagger$, $n \leq 20$) against a 384d sentence encoder, but this advantage is doubly conditional: it diminishes with stronger text encoders (4/4 HB at 384d $\to$ 1/4 at 1024d) and partially overlaps with temporal position. Seven alternative methods (change-point detection, geometric distance, representation engineering, cross-model transfer) all fail to match supervised probing. Metric-induced layer selection bias is the robust methodological finding; the empirical HS advantage is conditional on encoder quality, model scale, and position control.

\section{Conclusion}\label{sec:conclusion}

The choice of layer selection metric can reverse the central conclusion of a hidden-state safety study: for QwQ-32B, the same data yield $p{=}0.83$ or $p{<}0.005$ depending solely on metric choice. The HS advantage is validated at 7--8B (+20--22pp, nested CV) and exploratory$^\dagger$ at 32B (+15--19pp) against 384d encoders, but doubly conditional on encoder quality and position overlap. The study is limited to one benchmark with predominantly Qwen-family models (3/4); causal validation and broader architecture coverage remain necessary.\looseness=-1

1	\section{Experiments}\label{sec:experiments}
2	
3	We evaluate temporal probes across four reasoning models (\cref{tab:models}), comparing hidden-state (HS) and text modalities under different layer selection criteria.
4	
5	\paragraph{Evidence gradient.} We classify HS advantage evidence into three tiers: \emph{cross-validated}\footnote{In our usage, \emph{cross-validated} means the result survives nested 5-fold cross-validation with a held-out test fold, ruling out hyperparameter overfitting. \emph{Exploratory} ($\dagger$) results pass HB on the holdout split but lack nested CV validation due to sample constraints.} (nested CV pass; 7--8B models), \emph{significant} (HB pass without nested CV; QwQ-32B), and \emph{exploratory} ($^\dagger$, small sample or narrow coverage; R1-32B). Per-model details follow in \cref{sec:layer-results,sec:hs-text,sec:32b-analysis}.
6	
7	\subsection{Setup}\label{sec:setup}
8	
9	We study R1-8B (Llama-8B, R1-distilled, $n{=}43$ test traces), OT-7B (OpenThinker-7B, trained on the OpenThoughts dataset~\citep{openthinker}; Qwen-7B backbone, STILL-trained~\cref{app:ot7b_details}, $n{=}47$), QwQ-32B (Qwen-32B, native reasoning, $n{=}19$--$20$), and R1-32B (Qwen-32B, R1-distilled, $n{=}20$). All traces come from HarmThoughts with step-level CP annotations (60/20/20 split). HS probes extract last-token hidden states from a selected layer; text probes encode each step with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (384d). Both use L2-regularized logistic regression with temporal windowing $W \in \{1, 3, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25\}$ selected on validation. Classification requires $K{=}5$ consecutive threshold crossings (\cref{tab:k_ablation}). Statistical testing follows \cref{sec:evaluation}.\looseness=-1
10	
11	\subsection{Layer Selection Results}\label{sec:layer-results}
12	
13	\cref{tab:layer_selection} shows that the crossing-rate composite metric (balanced accuracy $\times$ crossing rate) systematically selects shallow layers across all four models: L0 for R1-8B (full L0--L24 sweep; \cref{tab:r18b_full_layer}) and OT-7B, L2 (3\%) for QwQ-32B, and L10 (16\%) for R1-32B. The three threshold-based metrics (precision, inverse FPR, additive composite) share a common confusion matrix and empirically converge to the same deep layer, L63 (98\%) for both 32B models, consistent with their shared structure, though not mathematically guaranteed. Pure balanced accuracy, a threshold-free metric, selects layers that vary across data splits and models (7--98\% depth under 60/20/20; \cref{app:ba_layer_comparison}), itself demonstrating that layer selection is a consequential methodological choice. The mechanism is that shallow layers produce highly compressed representations with small inter-step margins: step-to-step cosine distances are 1.4--2.7$\times$ smaller than at deep layers across all models (\cref{app:cosine_volatility}). A linear probe in this compressed space operates near the noise floor, generating frequent threshold crossings that inflate crossing rate independently of discriminative power (\cref{sec:layer-sensitivity}).\looseness=-1
14	
15	\begin{table}[t]
16	\centering
17	\small
18	\resizebox{\columnwidth}{!}{%
19	\begin{tabular}{lcccc}
20	\toprule
21	\textbf{Model} & \textbf{CR-comp.}$^a$ & \textbf{Thresh.}$^b$ & $p$ \textbf{(thresh.)} & $\Delta$\textbf{Prec}$^c$ \\
22	\midrule
23	R1-8B & L0 (0\%) & L14 (44\%) & ${<}0.001$ & +20.1 \\
24	OT-7B & L0 (0\%) & L16 (57\%) & ${<}0.001$ & +21.9 \\
25	QwQ-32B$^\dagger$ & L2 (3\%) & L63 (98\%) & ${<}0.005$ & +19.2 \\
26	R1-32B$^\dagger$ & L10 (16\%) & L63 (98\%) & ${<}0.001$ & +15.4 \\
27	\bottomrule
28	\end{tabular}}
29	\caption{Layer selection sensitivity. $^a$\,Crossing-rate composite (bal\_acc $\times$ crossing\_rate). $^b$\,Consensus of threshold-based metrics (precision, inverse FPR, additive composite). $^c$\,HS$-$text precision difference (pp) at threshold-based layer (\cref{tab:hs_vs_text}). Rightmost $p$: HS vs.\ text precision $p$-value at threshold-based layer (e.g., QwQ-32B CR-composite layer: $p{=}0.83$, non-significant). $\dagger$\,Sample-limited ($n \leq 20$).}
30	\label{tab:layer_selection}
31	\end{table}
32	
33	\begin{figure}[t]
34	\centering
35	\includegraphics[width=\columnwidth]{figures/fig_layer_heatmap.pdf}
36	\caption{Per-layer metric heatmap (2$\times$2). Each column: one of five metrics (min-max normalized). Blue dashed: CR-composite layer (bal\_acc $\times$ crossing\_rate); orange dash-dot: threshold-based layer (consensus of threshold-based metrics). For R1-8B (full L0--L24 sweep), crossing rate drives CR-composite selection to L0 while threshold-based metrics retain L14. At 32B, CR-composite selections cluster near input layers while threshold-based metrics peak at deep layers.}
37	\label{fig:layer_heatmap}
38	\end{figure}
39	
40	The downstream impact is severe: at CR-composite layers, only the two 7--8B models show significant HS advantage; both 32B models fail. At threshold-based layers, the HS advantage is graded: cross-validated at 7--8B (OT-7B, R1-8B; nested CV), significant but suggestive of position-competitiveness at QwQ-32B$^\dagger$, and exploratory at R1-32B$^\dagger$ (residualized gap below MDE). The $\dagger$ marks sample-limited test sets ($n \leq 20$) where effect sizes are descriptive rather than confirmatory. Had we reported only CR-composite-layer results, we would have concluded a scale-dependent HS advantage that is entirely a methodological artifact. Random-label controls on QwQ-32B and R1-8B confirm that threshold-based deep-layer selection requires genuine safety labels; the geometric shallow-layer bias is Qwen-specific: retained on QwQ-32B but dissolved on R1-8B (\cref{app:random_cp}). AUROC, excluded from our primary metrics because it is threshold-free (\cref{sec:evaluation}), confirms HS discriminability at BA-selected layers ($\Delta$AUROC +12.1 to +15.1pp; \cref{tab:ba_layer_results}) but cannot diagnose the threshold-dependent layer selection bias.\looseness=-1
41	
42	\subsection{HS vs.\ Text Comparison}\label{sec:hs-text}
43	
44	\begin{table}[t]
45	\centering
46	\small
47	\resizebox{\columnwidth}{!}{%
48	\begin{tabular}{llclrrlrc}
49	\toprule
50	\textbf{Model} & \textbf{Layer} & \textbf{Enc.} & $W$ & $\Delta$\textbf{BA} & $\Delta$\textbf{Prec} & \textbf{95\% CI} & $\Delta$\textbf{FPR} & \textbf{HB} \\
51	\midrule
52	R1-8B & L14 & 384d & 3 & +17.5 & +20.1 & [+12.4, +28.3] & $-$7.9 & \checkmark \\
53	 & & 1024d & & \multicolumn{1}{c}{--} & +5.8 & [$-$7.4, +19.5] & \multicolumn{1}{c}{--} & \\[2pt]
54	OT-7B & L16 & 384d & 3 & +10.7 & +21.9 & [+14.4, +29.6] & $-$17.1 & \checkmark \\
55	 & & 1024d & & \multicolumn{1}{c}{--} & +18.1 & [+8.4, +29.0] & \multicolumn{1}{c}{--} & \checkmark \\[2pt]
56	QwQ$^\dagger$ & L63 & 384d & 5 & +13.0 & +19.2 & [+9.3, +33.5] & $-$15.0 & \checkmark \\
57	 & & 1024d & & \multicolumn{1}{c}{--} & +9.4 & [$-$7.1, +27.7] & \multicolumn{1}{c}{--} & \\[2pt]
58	R1-32B$^\dagger$ & L63 & 384d & 1 & +18.7 & +15.4 & [+8.7, +22.6] & $-$14.6 & \checkmark \\
59	 & & 1024d & & \multicolumn{1}{c}{--} & +11.7 & [$-$0.2, +24.3] & \multicolumn{1}{c}{--} & \\
60	\bottomrule
61	\end{tabular}}
62	\caption{HS vs.\ text at threshold-based layers (LR probes, 60/20/20 split, 10{,}000 bootstrap resamples). Enc.: text encoder (384d = MiniLM-L6-v2, 1024d = BGE-large). $\Delta$: HS$-$text difference (pp); ``--'' = BA and FPR are not computed for the 1024d comparison because the 384d and 1024d encoders operate at different probe calibration points and do not share a decision threshold. HB: \checkmark{} = model-level test passes Holm-Bonferroni ($\alpha{=}0.05$); all 384d model-level tests pass. $^\dagger$\,Sample-limited ($n \leq 20$); 32B results are exploratory. 1024d: HB over 4 model-level precision tests.}
63	\label{tab:hs_vs_text}
64	\end{table}
65	
66	The HS advantage is encoder-conditional: against BGE-large (1024d), only OT-7B survives HB correction (\cref{app:encoder_robustness}). Multi-seed stability appears in \cref{app:multi_seed}. Against the 384d baseline, HS probes outperform text probes in all four models$^\dagger$ (\cref{tab:hs_vs_text}): cross-validated at 7--8B (OT-7B: +21.9pp precision, R1-8B: +20.1pp), significant but suggestive of position-competitiveness at QwQ-32B$^\dagger$ (+19.2pp), and exploratory at R1-32B$^\dagger$ (+15.4pp, pattern consistent with position mediation). R1-8B FPR is directionally consistent (5/5 seeds) but not robust ($p{=}0.044$, rank 12/12 in HB step-down; 1/5 seeds Bonferroni; \cref{app:multi_seed}). R1-32B passes 5/5 seeds but shows a pattern consistent with position mediation (residualized gap NS; \cref{app:position_residual}); QwQ-32B's position baseline is competitive (\cref{sec:32b-analysis}). Overall, 18/20 model-seed combinations pass full HB (\cref{app:multi_seed}). Control task selectivity confirms genuine safety signal: 11.1--16.8pp above chance (\cref{app:control}). A split-half analysis on OT-7B confirms internal validity (\cref{app:split_half}).\looseness=-1
67	
68	\paragraph{Capacity control.} PCA reduction of HS features to 384d (79--92\% variance retained) preserves the precision advantage across all four models$^\dagger$ (+16.8 to +23.1pp, all $p{<}0.012$, all HB). The control provides partial evidence against a pure capacity explanation. Random projection to 384d yields similar results ($\Delta$Prec +8.3 to +20.5pp; \cref{app:random_projection}), further weakening the capacity explanation. E5-Mistral-7B (4096d$\rightarrow$PCA 384d) yields intermediate results (2/4 HB; \cref{app:e5_mistral}), forming a monotonic encoder-quality gradient with MiniLM (4/4) and BGE-large (1/4).\looseness=-1
69	
70	\paragraph{Encoder robustness.} Against BGE-large~\citep{xiao2023cpack} (1024d), only OT-7B survives HB (1/4 precision); R1-8B shows adverse FPR direction (+1.2pp). This forms a monotonic encoder-quality gradient: MiniLM-384d (4/4 HB) $\to$ E5-Mistral-4096d$\to$384d (2/4) $\to$ BGE-large-1024d (1/4), with the precision advantage narrowing from +15--22pp to +6--12pp. The HS advantage is thus a function of text encoder capacity (\cref{fig:forest_precision}); layer selection (Contribution 1) is encoder-independent.\looseness=-1
71	
72	\paragraph{Position mediation.} Position ($t/T$) accounts for 9--20pp of balanced accuracy,\footnote{R1-32B's 20.4pp drop reflects $W{=}1$; at $W{\geq}3$, drops are 9--17pp.} but all models retain non-positional signal above chance (all $p{<}0.001$; \cref{app:position_residual}). Three of four models retain significant non-positional HS advantage (residualized gap +3.7 to +6.9pp, HB corrected); R1-32B's gap is +1.9pp ($p{=}0.914$, $n{=}20$). Adding a quadratic position term $(t/T)^2$ does not change significance conclusions for the 7--8B models. However, QwQ-32B's advantage is fully absorbed by the quadratic term (\cref{tab:position_quadratic}), suggesting its residualized advantage contains a non-linear position component. Temporal windowing reduces position dependence (24.3pp drop at $W{=}3$ vs.\ 16.5pp at $W{=}15$).\looseness=-1
73	
74	\paragraph{Caveats.} Nested 5-fold CV confirms the HS precision advantage for both 7--8B models (10/10 folds; \cref{app:nested_cv}), with shrinkage of 13--25\% relative to holdout estimates. OT-7B nested CV selects L21--27 vs.\ holdout L16 vs.\ CR-composite L0; the +21.9pp holdout estimate is an upper bound. R1-32B achieves significance only at $W{=}1$ with 25\% coverage; at $W{\geq}3$, dimensionality prevents significance. QwQ-32B HS lead time is negative ($-$1.2 to +1.9 steps). False alarm rates remain 11--50\%, so current methods characterize the phenomenon rather than constitute production detectors. Per-model details in \cref{sec:32b-analysis}.\looseness=-1
75	
76	\subsection{32B Model-Specific Analysis}\label{sec:32b-analysis}
77	
78	\paragraph{Exploratory 32B analysis.} Both 32B results are exploratory ($n{=}19$--$20$ precludes nested CV). LOO-CV and multi-seed analyses (\cref{app:layer_sweep,app:multi_seed}) provide partial robustness checks but do not substitute for independent validation. R1-32B and QwQ-32B share the Qwen-32B architecture but present opposite detection profiles (\cref{tab:32b_divergence}); training method is one plausible differentiator. Replication with $n{\geq}50$ traces is needed.\looseness=-1
79	
80	\begin{table}[t]
81	\centering
82	\small
83	\resizebox{\columnwidth}{!}{%
84	\begin{tabular}{lcccc}
85	\toprule
86	\textbf{Model} & \textbf{Cov.} & \textbf{Lead (steps)} & \textbf{HB} & \textbf{Pos.\ margin} \\
87	\midrule
88	R1-32B$^\dagger$ & 25\% & +11.7 to +13.3 & \checkmark{} ($W{=}1$) & +14.2pp \\
89	QwQ-32B$^\dagger$ & 74\% & $-$1.2 to +1.9 & \checkmark{} (all $W$) & $-$3.6pp \\
90	\bottomrule
91	\end{tabular}}
92	\caption{32B cross-model divergence ($\dagger$\,sample-limited, $n \leq 20$; MDE at 80\% power: 8.6--9.5pp, \cref{app:power_analysis}; all conclusions exploratory). R1-32B provides limited early identification with narrow coverage; QwQ-32B provides robust significance with poor lead time. HB: \checkmark{} = passes Holm-Bonferroni ($\alpha{=}0.05$). Pos.\ margin: HS BA minus position baseline.}
93	\label{tab:32b_divergence}
94	\end{table}
95	
96	R1-32B suggests commitment 11--13 steps early (+14.2pp over position baseline) but covers only 25\% of traces ($W{=}1$); the precision effect (+15.4pp, CI width 13.9pp) falls below MDE at 80\% power. QwQ-32B achieves significance at all window sizes with 74\% coverage but negative HS lead time; the precision effect (+19.2pp, CI width 24.2pp) exceeds MDE (8.6--9.5pp; \cref{app:power_analysis}) but the position baseline achieves higher BA (0.832 vs.\ 0.796), and the HS precision margin over position (+4.5pp, $p{=}0.133$; \cref{app:position_residual}) is not significant at $n{=}19$. The divergence suggests per-model validation is needed.\looseness=-1
97	
98	\subsection{Temporal Context}\label{sec:temporal}
99	
100	Temporal windowing ($W{>}1$) improves both modalities (\cref{fig:window_ablation}): at 7--8B, the modality advantage (+20.1 to +21.9pp) exceeds temporal improvement (+13pp). GRU models achieve comparable accuracy but higher FPR (\cref{tab:gru_multi_seeds,app:temporal_details}); an adaptive two-stage strategy offers marginal gains (\cref{app:two_stage}).\looseness=-1
101	
102	\begin{figure}[t]
103	\centering
104	\includegraphics[width=\columnwidth]{figures/fig_forest_precision.pdf}
105	\caption{Forest plot of HS precision advantage over text probes. Blue: vs.\ MiniLM-384d; orange: vs.\ BGE-1024d. Solid markers: survives Holm-Bonferroni; hollow: does not. All 384d comparisons are significant (strong to qualified evidence); against BGE-1024d, only OT-7B (strong) survives correction.}
106	\label{fig:forest_precision}
107	\end{figure}
108	
109	CP-aligned probe score trajectories (\cref{fig:trajectory} in Appendix) confirm sharper HS transitions at the commitment point, with OT-7B showing the clearest separation and R1-32B the weakest.\looseness=-1
110	
111	\enlargethispage{10\baselineskip}
112	\subsection{Negative Results}\label{sec:negative}
113	
114	No alternative method consistently matches supervised probing (\cref{tab:negative}). BOCPD~\citep{adams2007bayesian}/CUSUM fail (0\% detection on 3/4 models); Mahalanobis yields near-zero separation; RepE~\citep{zou2023representation} is model-dependent (BA 0.756 vs.\ 0.559); MLP probes overfit; CCS misaligns temporally; cross-model transfer fails (\cref{app:negative_details}). -Crossing rate reverses the central finding via shallow-layer compression (\cref{app:cosine_volatility,tab:r18b_full_layer}); random-label controls confirm genuine safety labels are required (\cref{app:random_cp}). The metric-layer interaction is asymmetric: crossing rate's shallow preference is artifactual (cosine compression inflates threshold crossings independently of discriminative power), while threshold-based metrics' deep preference reflects genuinely improving probe separability with depth~\citep{tenney2019bert}, not a comparable artifact. Contribution~1 generalizes across all four models tested (3 Qwen, 1 Llama), with cross-dataset evidence (AdvBench $1.67\times$; \cref{app:cosine_volatility}) and split-half replication (\cref{app:split_half}); Contribution~2 is sample-dependent. [审稿报告]
Overall: 3.0 Findings

# 审稿报告 — Round 29 (Fresh Review)

**论文**: Layer Selection Sensitivity in Hidden-State Safety Probes for Reasoning Models
**Venue**: EMNLP 2026 (via ARR)
**审稿模式**: 重新审稿 (fresh)
**Reviewer**: R1 (方法严谨性+统计有效性) + R2 (新颖性+完整性+写作)

---

## Summary

论文定义了 reasoning model 推理链中的 Safety Commitment Point (CP)，系统比较了 hidden-state (HS) 和 text probes 在 4 个 reasoning LLM (3 Qwen + 1 Llama, 7-8B 和 32B) 上的 CP 检测能力。核心发现是方法论性质的：layer selection metric 的选择可以定性地逆转 HS probe 的结论——crossing-rate composite metric 系统性选浅层（所有模型），而 threshold-based metrics 选深层，两者在 32B 模型上产生 p=0.83 vs p<0.005 的逆转。在 threshold-based 层上，HS 对 384d text encoder 有 +15-22pp precision 优势（7-8B cross-validated, 32B exploratory），但此优势随 text encoder 质量提升而缩减（1024d 下仅 1/4 模型显著），且与 temporal position 部分重叠。

---

## Strengths

**S1. 方法论严谨性在同类 probing 论文中罕见。** 5-metric taxonomy、bootstrap 10k resamples + Holm-Bonferroni 12-test 校正、random-label decomposition control、Hewitt & Liang control tasks、nested 5-fold CV (7-8B)、evidence gradient 三级分类——多层防线对抗虚假发现。[R1+R2 consensus]

**S2. Bug disclosure (M002) 是模范级科研透明度。** 完整记录 QwQ-32B text probe pipeline bug 的发现、影响和修正过程。[R1+R2 consensus]

**S3. Negative results 系统且有价值。** 7 种替代方法（BOCPD/CUSUM/MLP/CCS/RepE/Mahalanobis/cross-transfer）的失败及原因分析，对后续研究者有直接参考价值。[R1+R2 consensus]

**S4. Evidence gradient 分类法避免了典型 probing 论文的 overclaim。** cross-validated / significant / exploratory 三级分类，32B 全文标注 exploratory†，统计报告诚实。[R1+R2 consensus]

**S5. Encoder-conditional HS advantage 的 doubly conditional framing 科学准确。** 同时报告 encoder quality gradient (384d→1024d: 4/4→1/4 HB) 和 position overlap (linear 3/4, quadratic 2/4)。[R1+R2 consensus]

---

## Weaknesses

### Must-Fix（影响接收决定）

**MF1. [consensus] 主文缺少 conditional inference caveat——HB 校正的 12 tests 是条件于已选层和窗口的推断，而非对 ~2,240 搜索空间的 marginal inference。**
- R1-N1 Critical + R2 AGREE
- 主文 Table 3/Abstract 报告的 p-values 会让读者误以为是 unconditional significance。Appendix W 的 conditional inference 讨论必须出现在主文中。32B validation fold 仅 ~4 traces，selection overfitting 风险高。
- **建议**：主文 Section 3.5 或 4 明确 conditional inference 性质；报告 effective degrees of freedom；考虑 permutation-based marginal coverage 或 post-selection inference (Berk et al., 2013)。
- 关联 issue: R26-N1 (recurring since R26, 至今 4 轮未完全解决)

**MF2. [consensus] E5-Mistral PCA 降维混淆——4096d→384d PCA 人为削弱 text probe，HS 优势可能是维度差异而非模态差异。**
- R1-N2 Critical + R2 AGREE
- Appendix U 将 E5-Mistral-7B (4096d) PCA 降至 384d "to match MiniLM dimensionality"，然后与 HS (4096d) 比较。这同时改变了 encoder quality 和 dimensionality，无法分离两个变量。
- **建议**：补充 4096d E5-Mistral 直接对比；或将 HS 也 PCA 降至 384d 做 capacity-matched 实验。若 HS 优势在维度匹配后消失，需重新表述 Contribution 2。
- 关联 issue: R29-N1 (新发现)

**MF3. [consensus] 模型多样性不足——3/4 Qwen 架构，标题 "four reasoning LLMs" 暗示的多样性高于实际。**
- R2-N2 Critical + R1 AGREE
- 论文自己在 Discussion 指出 crossing-rate shallow-layer bias 是 Qwen-specific (random-label decomposition: Qwen 保留几何偏差, Llama 消除)。仅 1 个 non-Qwen 模型不足以支撑架构通用性 claim。
- **建议**：标题增加架构限定（如 "across reasoning LLMs of two architectures"）；Abstract 明确 3/4 Qwen 这一事实。
- 关联 issue: R23-N2 (recurring since R23, 7 轮未完全解决)

### Should-Fix（影响评分）

**SF1. [consensus] 单数据集 (HarmThoughts) 限制核心 claim 普适性。**
- R2-N1 + R1-W2
- Metric reversal 可能是数据集特有现象。AdvBench 仅验证 geometric precondition (1.67×)，未验证 layer reversal 本身。R1 认为 metric reversal 存在性已在 4 models 上一致证明，将此降级为 Should-Fix。
- **建议**：在 AdvBench 上补充 layer sweep 验证 metric reversal 是否复现；或显著弱化 claim 措辞。
- 关联 issue: R22-W2, R23-N5 (recurring since R22)

**SF2. [consensus] QwQ-32B 在 abstract 中标 "significant" 但 n=19 且无 nested CV。**
- R1-W1 + R2 AGREE
- 与 Table 4 "sample-limited" 标注存在内部张力。建议降级为 "suggestive" 或 "provisionally significant"。
- 关联 issue: R26-N2

**SF3. [consensus] Abstract 信息过载。**
- R2-W2 + R1 AGREE
- 试图覆盖 7+ 独立发现，数字密度过高（"+15 to +22pp at 7-8B"），核心信息被稀释。
- **建议**：重组为 motivation(2句) → core finding(2-3句) → implication(1句)，具体数字移入正文。
- 关联 issue: R23-W4 (recurring since R23)

**SF4. [consensus] Discussion 过度压缩（半 column ~25行）。**
- R1-W3 + R2 AGREE (考虑 8-page 约束)
- 关键讨论（crossing rate 机制、metric reversal 因果方向、部署 implications）被推至附录。
- **建议**：精简 4.4/4.5/4.6 为 Discussion 腾空间。
- 关联 issue: R29-W2 (新发现)

**SF5. [consensus, R2 partial REBUT] Crossing-rate composite 缺理论动机。**
- R1-W4 + R2 partial REBUT
- R2 辩护：作为 foil/contrast case 展示 metric reversal 有合理性。但 R1+R2 均同意需补充 1-2 句设计 rationale（为何合理、在什么假设下应该 work）。
- 关联 issue: R26-W1

**SF6. [consensus] 32B 统计效力不足下的过度解读。**
- R2-W6 + R1 AGREE
- Discussion 对 32B 结果做较强解读（如 "crossing-rate bias is Qwen-specific"），但这可能仅因 sample size 不同。
- **建议**：Discussion 明确区分 7-8B (统计有力) vs 32B (统计效力不足)。
- 关联 issue: R22-W1, R26-N2

**SF7. [R2 raise, R1 partial agree] Evidence gradient 贡献定位模糊。**
- R2-W5 + R1 partial REBUT
- 在 Contributions list 中包装标准统计实践为 "contribution" 可能引起 overclaim 质疑。R1 认为有 corrective 价值但同意降级为 methodological recommendation。
- 关联 issue: R29-W1 (新发现)

**SF8. [consensus] Figure 1 (Layer Heatmap) ACL single-column 下可读性差。**
- R2-W4 + R1 AGREE
- 4×5 heatmap 在 single-column 下每个子图很小，颜色区分困难。Per-column normalization 使跨 metric 比较失效。
- **建议**：改为 full-width 或拆分为两图；axis label 字号加大。
- 关联 issue: R23-VIS (recurring since R23)

---

## Reviewer Consensus

所有关键问题均达成共识：

- **[AGREE]** Conditional inference caveat 必须出现在主文中 (MF1)
- **[AGREE]** E5-Mistral PCA 降维是 capacity confound (MF2)
- **[AGREE]** 3/4 Qwen 架构限制了 generalization claim (MF3)
- **[AGREE]** 单数据集是 structural limitation, Findings 可接受 (SF1)
- **[AGREE]** QwQ-32B "significant" 标签应降级 (SF2)
- **[AGREE]** Abstract 需重组 (SF3)
- **[AGREE]** Discussion 需扩展 (SF4)
- **[AGREE]** 32B 解读需更审慎 (SF6)

---

## Reviewer Divergence

**Excitement 评分分歧**：R1 给 3.5/5, R2 给 2.5/5。
- R1 认为揭示被整个领域忽视的方法论陷阱（可逆转已发表结论）有足够 excitement 达到 Conference threshold。
- R2 认为本质是 sensitivity analysis 而非新方法/新机制发现，impact 局限于 safety probing 子领域。
- **Director 判断**：分歧反映方法论审计类工作的评价标准差异。两者均认为 Findings track 合适。

**Chan & Yong (2025) 区分**：
- R2-W3 认为区分不充分（overlap 显著）
- R1 REBUT 认为 research questions 本质不同（"能否检测" vs "层选择如何影响检测结论"），当前讨论已足够
- **Director 判断**：R1 rebuttal 合理，当前 Related Work 已有约 10 行详细对比，可多用 2-3 句但非必须。

---

## Questions for Authors

**Q1.** [R2] Shallow layer cosine 聚类是否是 trivial artifact（overall variance 小）而非 safety-specific 压缩？是否测量了 shallow vs deep layers 的 overall variance？

**Q2.** [R1] E5-Mistral 为何 PCA 降至 384d 而非使用原始 4096d？这一选择的实验设计理由是什么？

**Q3.** [R1] 是否考虑过 permutation-based 方法估计整个搜索空间的 marginal type-I error rate？

**Q4.** [R2] R1-32B residualized 后 HS advantage 消失（+1.9pp, p=0.914）是否暗示其 HS advantage 完全由 position mediation 驱动？

**Q5.** [R2] 5-metric taxonomy 的选择有无 principled 理由，还是 pilot study 后 empirical 选定？

**Q6.** [R1] 32B 是否可用 LOO-CV 近似 nested validation？

**Q7.** [R1] FPR 11-50% 在实际部署中是否 actionable？Discussion 应更直接回答此问题。

**Q8.** [R2] Bug M002 影响 QwQ-32B text probe。是否对其他 model-modality 组合进行了 pipeline sanity check？

---

## Missing References

以下引用经两位 Reviewer 交叉确认为高相关：

1. **Li et al. (2024)** "Inference-Time Intervention: Eliciting Truthful Answers from a Language Model" — layer-specific probes for inference-time 干预，与本文 layer selection 问题直接相关 [R2 suggest, R1 AGREE]

2. **Levinstein & Herrmann (2024)** "Still No Lie Detector for Language Models" — 对 probing-based detection 的系统性批判，与 metric reversal 发现形成对话 [R2 suggest, R1 AGREE]

以下引用仅由一方提出，需作者自行验证：
- Gurnee et al. (2024) "Language Model Internals Reveal Progress Toward Safety" [R2 suggest, R1 无法确认]
- Nanda et al. (2023) / TransformerLens [R2 suggest, R1 REBUT: 与标准 linear probing 无关]

**引用验证结果**：80 条 bib entries 全部真实。0 orphan entries, 0 missing entries。5 条 minor mismatch（LaTeX 特殊字符编码），15 条近期 arXiv 未被 OpenAlex 索引（已知论文）。R2 报告 belrose2023tunedlens authors 为空实为误报（实际 authors 完整）。

---

## External Review

未配置外部审稿（Stanford Agentic Reviewer），跳过。

---

## Visual Layout Check（非评分项）

视觉审查 Agent 已完成（耗时 ~4 分钟）。0 critical, 4 warnings, 11 info。

**Warnings:**
1. **Pages 3-5 text wall**: 连续 3 页纯文本（Related Work + Methods），无 figure/table 穿插。审稿人在前半程缺少视觉锚点。
2. **Display items 后置集中**: 6 个 display items 全部在 pages 6-8，pages 1-5 仅有一个小型 Table 1。
3. **缺方法概览图**: 多组件方法（HS/text probes、temporal windowing、5-metric taxonomy）全靠文字描述，认知负担高。
4. **Figure 1 axis label 偏小**: 约正文 60% 字号，打印或低分辨率下难以辨认。

**Info (highlights):**
- Figure 2 (Forest plot) 清晰，色盲友好
- Table 格式规范 (booktabs)
- 附录结构完整（目录 + 30+ tables + 5 figures）
- References 无未解析引用
- Limitations 简短合规
- 页数合规（正文至 p8，Limitations 在 p9）

---

## Overall Assessment

**评分**: 3.0 (Findings)

**R1**: 3.5 (Borderline Conference) — Soundness 3.5, Excitement 3.5, Reproducibility 4.5
**R2**: 3.5 (Borderline Conference) — Soundness 4.0, Excitement 2.5, Reproducibility 4.0
**Director 综合**: 3.0 (Findings)

**理由**：

两位 Reviewer 独立给出 3.5，但 Director 基于以下考量降至 3.0：

1. **MF1 (conditional inference) 是跨轮次反复出现的系统性问题**（R22→R25→R26→R29，至今 4 轮未完全解决）——主文至今未明确 p-values 是 conditional on upstream selection 的推断。这对一篇以统计严谨性为卖点的论文是致命的。

2. **MF2 (E5-Mistral PCA confound) 是新发现的实验设计缺陷**——encoder robustness gradient (4/4→2/4→1/4 HB) 是 Contribution 2 的核心论据之一，但 E5-Mistral 数据点存在维度混淆，使 gradient 的第二个数据点不可靠。

3. **MF3 (Qwen 架构主导) 是跨轮次反复出现的结构性限制**（R23→R29，7 轮未解决）——标题和 abstract 仍暗示比实际更高的模型多样性。

4. **单数据集 (SF1) + 中等新颖性 (R2 Excitement 2.5)** 共同限制了 impact。Metric reversal 发现有实践价值但更适合 Findings track。

**修改后评分预期**：
- MF1 (主文加 conditional inference caveat) + MF2 (补 4096d 或 capacity-matched 对比) 处理后 → 3.5
- 若同时处理 MF3 (标题/abstract 架构限定) + SF1-SF4 → 有望冲 3.5-4.0 区间

**置信度**: 4/5

---

## Detailed Comments

### Abstract
- 信息密度过高，核心信息被 7+ findings 稀释。重组为 motivation→core finding→implication 结构。
- "+15 to +22pp" headline 来自 384d MiniLM baseline，应提及 encoder 条件。
- QwQ-32B "significant" 与 Table 4 "sample-limited" 存在张力。

### Introduction
- Contribution 1 (metric reversal) 定位准确，与 Belinkov (2022) 的增量清晰。
- Contribution 2 (boundary conditions) 命名得当。
- Evidence gradient 不应与前两个并列为独立 contribution。
- 缺方法概览图（当前 Table 1 信息价值有限）。

### Related Work
- Chan & Yong (2025) 对比充分（R1 确认 ~10 行详细讨论）。
- Boxo et al. (2025) 定位得当（text leakage complementary mechanism）。
- 缺 Li et al. (2024) ITI 和 Levinstein & Herrmann (2024)。
- Crossing rate 与 early exit consistency metrics 的概念差异需明确。

### Method
- L2 logistic regression 选择合理，C=1.0 robustness 已验证 (<2pp variation)。
- Temporal windowing 设计清晰，per-model validation W 选择合理。
- Section 3.5 必须加 conditional inference caveat。
- Crossing-rate composite 需补设计 rationale。

### Experiments
- Table 2 (layer selection) 是论文最有力的 table，直接展示 metric reversal。
- Table 3 (HS vs text) 结构清晰，dual-encoder 对比有参考价值。
- Section 4.4 (32B analysis) 标注得当（exploratory†, MDE）。
- Section 4.6 (negative results) 简洁有效。
- 建议精简 4.4-4.6 为 Discussion 腾空间。

### Discussion
- 仅半 column，关键机制解释被推至附录。
- 需补入：(1) cosine compression 关键发现摘要；(2) FPR 11-50% 的部署 implications；(3) conditional inference 性质。
- "Multi-metric audit" 建议有实践价值但 three-layer ensemble 作为 solution 需更强 disclaimer。

### Conclusion
- 压缩到 3 行过短。
- QwQ-32B quadratic position absorption 未反映。
- confirmed 7-8B 和 exploratory 32B 的区分已有但不够显著。

### Limitations
- 3 点覆盖合适（dataset scope, statistical power, architecture coverage）。
- 缺 BCa small-sample coverage 讨论。

### Appendix
- 内容极其充分（20+ pages，30+ tables）。
- Bug disclosure (M002) 是模范。
- 但主文应自包含关键论据，不应要求 reviewer 读 20 页附录才能评估核心 claims。

### 格式合规
- 页数合规 ✓（正文 8 页，Limitations/Ethics 在 p9）
- Double-blind ✓（Anonymous ARR Submission）
- ACL template ✓
- Limitations ✓
- Ethics Statement ✓
- 注意：enlargethispage 10+11=21 baselineskip 在 page 8 较激进，可能被个别 reviewer 视为 gaming page limit。

# 审稿报告 — Round 29 (Fresh Review)

**论文**: Layer Selection Sensitivity in Hidden-State Safety Probes for Reasoning Models
**Venue**: EMNLP 2026 (via ARR)
**审稿模式**: 重新审稿 (fresh)

---

## Summary

论文定义了 reasoning model 推理链中的 Safety Commitment Point (CP)，系统比较了 hidden-state (HS) 和 text probes 在 4 个 reasoning LLM (3 Qwen + 1 Llama, 7-8B 和 32B) 上的 CP 检测能力。核心发现是方法论性质的：layer selection metric 的选择可以定性地逆转 HS probe 的结论——crossing-rate composite metric 系统性选浅层（所有模型），而 threshold-based metrics 选深层，两者在 32B 模型上产生 p=0.83 vs p<0.005 的逆转。在 threshold-based 层上，HS 对 384d text encoder 有 +15-22pp precision 优势（7-8B cross-validated, 32B exploratory），但此优势随 text encoder 质量提升而缩减（1024d 下仅 1/4 模型显著），且与 temporal position 部分重叠。

---

## Strengths

**S1. 方法论严谨性在同类 probing 论文中罕见。** 5-metric taxonomy、bootstrap 10k resamples + Holm-Bonferroni 12-test 校正、random-label decomposition control、Hewitt & Liang control tasks、nested 5-fold CV (7-8B)、evidence gradient 三级分类——多层防线对抗虚假发现。[R1+R2 consensus]

**S2. Bug disclosure (M002) 是模范级科研透明度。** 完整记录 QwQ-32B text probe pipeline bug 的发现、影响和修正过程。[R1+R2 consensus]

**S3. Negative results 系统且有价值。** 7 种替代方法（BOCPD/CUSUM/MLP/CCS/RepE/Mahalanobis/cross-transfer）的失败及原因分析，对后续研究者有直接参考价值。[R1+R2 consensus]

**S4. Evidence gradient 分类法避免了典型 probing 论文的 overclaim。** cross-validated / significant / exploratory 三级分类，32B 全文标注 exploratory†，统计报告诚实。[R1+R2 consensus]

**S5. Encoder-conditional HS advantage 的 doubly conditional framing 科学准确。** 同时报告 encoder quality gradient (384d→1024d: 4/4→1/4 HB) 和 position overlap (linear 3/4, quadratic 2/4)。[R1+R2 consensus]

---

## Weaknesses

### Must-Fix（影响接收决定）

**MF1. [consensus] 主文缺少 conditional inference caveat——HB 校正的 12 tests 是条件于已选层和窗口的推断，而非对 ~2,240 搜索空间的 marginal inference。**
- R1-N1 Critical + R2 AGREE
- 主文 Table 3/Abstract 报告的 p-values 会让读者误以为是 unconditional significance。Appendix W 的 conditional inference 讨论必须出现在主文中。32B validation fold 仅 ~4 traces，selection overfitting 风险高。
- **建议**：主文 Section 3.5 或 4 明确 conditional inference 性质；报告 effective degrees of freedom；考虑 permutation-based marginal coverage 或 post-selection inference (Berk et al., 2013)。
- 关联 issue: R26-N1 (recurring since R26, 至今 4 轮未完全解决)

**MF2. [consensus] E5-Mistral PCA 降维混淆——4096d→384d PCA 人为削弱 text probe，HS 优势可能是维度差异而非模态差异。**
- R1-N2 Critical + R2 AGREE
- Appendix U 将 E5-Mistral-7B (4096d) PCA 降至 384d "to match MiniLM dimensionality"，然后与 HS (4096d) 比较。这同时改变了 encoder quality 和 dimensionality，无法分离两个变量。
- **建议**：补充 4096d E5-Mistral 直接对比；或将 HS 也 PCA 降至 384d 做 capacity-matched 实验。若 HS 优势在维度匹配后消失，需重新表述 Contribution 2。
- 关联 issue: R29-N1 (新发现)

**MF3. [consensus] 模型多样性不足——3/4 Qwen 架构，标题 "four reasoning LLMs" 暗示的多样性高于实际。**
- R2-N2 Critical + R1 AGREE
- 论文自己在 Discussion 指出 crossing-rate shallow-layer bias 是 Qwen-specific (random-label decomposition: Qwen 保留几何偏差, Llama 消除)。仅 1 个 non-Qwen 模型不足以支撑架构通用性 claim。
- **建议**：标题增加架构限定（如 "across reasoning LLMs of two architectures"）；Abstract 明确 3/4 Qwen 这一事实。
- 关联 issue: R23-N2 (recurring since R23, 7 轮未完全解决)

### Should-Fix（影响评分）

**SF1. [consensus] 单数据集 (HarmThoughts) 限制核心 claim 普适性。**
- R2-N1 + R1-W2
- Metric reversal 可能是数据集特有现象。AdvBench 仅验证 geometric precondition (1.67×)，未验证 layer reversal 本身。R1 认为 metric reversal 存在性已在 4 models 上一致证明，将此降级为 Should-Fix。
- **建议**：在 AdvBench 上补充 layer sweep 验证 metric reversal 是否复现；或显著弱化 claim 措辞。
- 关联 issue: R22-W2, R23-N5 (recurring since R22)

**SF2. [consensus] QwQ-32B 在 abstract 中标 "significant" 但 n=19 且无 nested CV。**
- R1-W1 + R2 AGREE
- 与 Table 4 "sample-limited" 标注存在内部张力。建议降级为 "suggestive" 或 "provisionally significant"。
- 关联 issue: R26-N2

**SF3. [consensus] Abstract 信息过载。**
- R2-W2 + R1 AGREE
- 试图覆盖 7+ 独立发现，数字密度过高（"+15 to +22pp at 7-8B"），核心信息被稀释。
- **建议**：重组为 motivation(2句) → core finding(2-3句) → implication(1句)，具体数字移入正文。
- 关联 issue: R23-W4 (recurring since R23)

**SF4. [consensus] Discussion 过度压缩（半 column ~25行）。**
- R1-W3 + R2 AGREE (考虑 8-page 约束)
- 关键讨论（crossing rate 机制、metric reversal 因果方向、部署 implications）被推至附录。
- **建议**：精简 4.4/4.5/4.6 为 Discussion 腾空间。
- 关联 issue: R29-W2 (新发现)

**SF5. [consensus, R2 partial REBUT] Crossing-rate composite 缺理论动机。**
- R1-W4 + R2 partial REBUT
- R2 辩护：作为 foil/contrast case 展示 metric reversal 有合理性。但 R1+R2 均同意需补充 1-2 句设计 rationale（为何合理、在什么假设下应该 work）。
- 关联 issue: R26-W1

**SF6. [consensus] 32B 统计效力不足下的过度解读。**
- R2-W6 + R1 AGREE
- Discussion 对 32B 结果做较强解读（如 "crossing-rate bias is Qwen-specific"），但这可能仅因 sample size 不同。
- **建议**：Discussion 明确区分 7-8B (统计有力) vs 32B (统计效力不足)。
- 关联 issue: R22-W1, R26-N2

**SF7. [R2 raise, R1 partial agree] Evidence gradient 贡献定位模糊。**
- R2-W5 + R1 partial REBUT
- 在 Contributions list 中包装标准统计实践为 "contribution" 可能引起 overclaim 质疑。R1 认为有 corrective 价值但同意降级为 methodological recommendation。
- 关联 issue: R29-W1 (新发现)

**SF8. [consensus] Figure 1 (Layer Heatmap) ACL single-column 下可读性差。**
- R2-W4 + R1 AGREE
- 4×5 heatmap 在 single-column 下每个子图很小，颜色区分困难。Per-column normalization 使跨 metric 比较失效。
- **建议**：改为 full-width 或拆分为两图；axis label 字号加大。
- 关联 issue: R23-VIS (recurring since R23)

---

## Reviewer Consensus

所有关键问题均达成共识：

- **[AGREE]** Conditional inference caveat 必须出现在主文中 (MF1)
- **[AGREE]** E5-Mistral PCA 降维是 capacity confound (MF2)
- **[AGREE]** 3/4 Qwen 架构限制了 generalization claim (MF3)
- **[AGREE]** 单数据集是 structural limitation, Findings 可接受 (SF1)
- **[AGREE]** QwQ-32B "significant" 标签应降级 (SF2)
- **[AGREE]** Abstract 需重组 (SF3)
- **[AGREE]** Discussion 需扩展 (SF4)
- **[AGREE]** 32B 解读需更审慎 (SF6)

---

## Reviewer Divergence

**Excitement 评分分歧**：R1 给 3.5/5, R2 给 2.5/5。
- R1 认为揭示被整个领域忽视的方法论陷阱（可逆转已发表结论）有足够 excitement 达到 Conference threshold。
- R2 认为本质是 sensitivity analysis 而非新方法/新机制发现，impact 局限于 safety probing 子领域。
- **Director 判断**：分歧反映方法论审计类工作的评价标准差异。两者均认为 Findings track 合适。

**Chan & Yong (2025) 区分**：
- R2-W3 认为区分不充分（overlap 显著）
- R1 REBUT 认为 research questions 本质不同（"能否检测" vs "层选择如何影响检测结论"），当前讨论已足够
- **Director 判断**：R1 rebuttal 合理，当前 Related Work 已有约 10 行详细对比，可多用 2-3 句但非必须。

---

## Questions for Authors

**Q1.** [R2] Shallow layer cosine 聚类是否是 trivial artifact（overall variance 小）而非 safety-specific 压缩？是否测量了 shallow vs deep layers 的 overall variance？

**Q2.** [R1] E5-Mistral 为何 PCA 降至 384d 而非使用原始 4096d？这一选择的实验设计理由是什么？

**Q3.** [R1] 是否考虑过 permutation-based 方法估计整个搜索空间的 marginal type-I error rate？

**Q4.** [R2] R1-32B residualized 后 HS advantage 消失（+1.9pp, p=0.914）是否暗示其 HS advantage 完全由 position mediation 驱动？

**Q5.** [R2] 5-metric taxonomy 的选择有无 principled 理由，还是 pilot study 后 empirical 选定？

**Q6.** [R1] 32B 是否可用 LOO-CV 近似 nested validation？

**Q7.** [R1] FPR 11-50% 在实际部署中是否 actionable？Discussion 应更直接回答此问题。

**Q8.** [R2] Bug M002 影响 QwQ-32B text probe。是否对其他 model-modality 组合进行了 pipeline sanity check？

---

## Missing References

以下引用经两位 Reviewer 交叉确认为高相关：

1. **Li et al. (2024)** "Inference-Time Intervention: Eliciting Truthful Answers from a Language Model" — layer-specific probes for inference-time 干预，与本文 layer selection 问题直接相关 [R2 suggest, R1 AGREE]

2. **Levinstein & Herrmann (2024)** "Still No Lie Detector for Language Models" — 对 probing-based detection 的系统性批判，与 metric reversal 发现形成对话 [R2 suggest, R1 AGREE]

以下引用仅由一方提出，需作者自行验证：
- Gurnee et al. (2024) "Language Model Internals Reveal Progress Toward Safety" [R2 suggest, R1 无法确认]
- Nanda et al. (2023) / TransformerLens [R2 suggest, R1 REBUT: 与标准 linear probing 无关]

**引用验证结果**：80 条 bib entries 全部真实。0 orphan entries, 0 missing entries。5 条 minor mismatch（LaTeX 特殊字符编码），15 条近期 arXiv 未被 OpenAlex 索引（已知论文）。R2 报告 belrose2023tunedlens authors 为空实为误报（实际 authors 完整）。

---

## External Review

未配置外部审稿（Stanford Agentic Reviewer），跳过。

---

## Visual Layout Check（非评分项）

视觉审查 Agent 已完成（耗时 ~4 分钟）。0 critical, 4 warnings, 11 info。

**Warnings:**
1. **Pages 3-5 text wall**: 连续 3 页纯文本（Related Work + Methods），无 figure/table 穿插。审稿人在前半程缺少视觉锚点。
2. **Display items 后置集中**: 6 个 display items 全部在 pages 6-8，pages 1-5 仅有一个小型 Table 1。
3. **缺方法概览图**: 多组件方法（HS/text probes、temporal windowing、5-metric taxonomy）全靠文字描述，认知负担高。
4. **Figure 1 axis label 偏小**: 约正文 60% 字号，打印或低分辨率下难以辨认。

**Info (highlights):**
- Figure 2 (Forest plot) 清晰，色盲友好
- Table 格式规范 (booktabs)
- 附录结构完整（目录 + 30+ tables + 5 figures）
- References 无未解析引用
- Limitations 简短合规
- 页数合规（正文至 p8，Limitations 在 p9）

---

## Overall Assessment

**评分**: 3.0 (Findings)

**R1**: 3.5 (Borderline Conference) — Soundness 3.5, Excitement 3.5, Reproducibility 4.5
**R2**: 3.5 (Borderline Conference) — Soundness 4.0, Excitement 2.5, Reproducibility 4.0
**Director 综合**: 3.0 (Findings)

**理由**：

两位 Reviewer 独立给出 3.5，但 Director 基于以下考量降至 3.0：

1. **MF1 (conditional inference) 是跨轮次反复出现的系统性问题**（R22→R25→R26→R29，至今 4 轮未完全解决）——主文至今未明确 p-values 是 conditional on upstream selection 的推断。这对一篇以统计严谨性为卖点的论文是致命的。

2. **MF2 (E5-Mistral PCA confound) 是新发现的实验设计缺陷**——encoder robustness gradient (4/4→2/4→1/4 HB) 是 Contribution 2 的核心论据之一，但 E5-Mistral 数据点存在维度混淆，使 gradient 的第二个数据点不可靠。

3. **MF3 (Qwen 架构主导) 是跨轮次反复出现的结构性限制**（R23→R29，7 轮未解决）——标题和 abstract 仍暗示比实际更高的模型多样性。

4. **单数据集 (SF1) + 中等新颖性 (R2 Excitement 2.5)** 共同限制了 impact。Metric reversal 发现有实践价值但更适合 Findings track。

**修改后评分预期**：
- MF1 (主文加 conditional inference caveat) + MF2 (补 4096d 或 capacity-matched 对比) 处理后 → 3.5
- 若同时处理 MF3 (标题/abstract 架构限定) + SF1-SF4 → 有望冲 3.5-4.0 区间

**置信度**: 4/5

---

## Detailed Comments

### Abstract
- 信息密度过高，核心信息被 7+ findings 稀释。重组为 motivation→core finding→implication 结构。
- "+15 to +22pp" headline 来自 384d MiniLM baseline，应提及 encoder 条件。
- QwQ-32B "significant" 与 Table 4 "sample-limited" 存在张力。

### Introduction
- Contribution 1 (metric reversal) 定位准确，与 Belinkov (2022) 的增量清晰。
- Contribution 2 (boundary conditions) 命名得当。
- Evidence gradient 不应与前两个并列为独立 contribution。
- 缺方法概览图（当前 Table 1 信息价值有限）。

### Related Work
- Chan & Yong (2025) 对比充分（R1 确认 ~10 行详细讨论）。
- Boxo et al. (2025) 定位得当（text leakage complementary mechanism）。
- 缺 Li et al. (2024) ITI 和 Levinstein & Herrmann (2024)。
- Crossing rate 与 early exit consistency metrics 的概念差异需明确。

### Method
- L2 logistic regression 选择合理，C=1.0 robustness 已验证 (<2pp variation)。
- Temporal windowing 设计清晰，per-model validation W 选择合理。
- Section 3.5 必须加 conditional inference caveat。
- Crossing-rate composite 需补设计 rationale。

### Experiments
- Table 2 (layer selection) 是论文最有力的 table，直接展示 metric reversal。
- Table 3 (HS vs text) 结构清晰，dual-encoder 对比有参考价值。
- Section 4.4 (32B analysis) 标注得当（exploratory†, MDE）。
- Section 4.6 (negative results) 简洁有效。
- 建议精简 4.4-4.6 为 Discussion 腾空间。

### Discussion
- 仅半 column，关键机制解释被推至附录。
- 需补入：(1) cosine compression 关键发现摘要；(2) FPR 11-50% 的部署 implications；(3) conditional inference 性质。
- "Multi-metric audit" 建议有实践价值但 three-layer ensemble 作为 solution 需更强 disclaimer。

### Conclusion
- 压缩到 3 行过短。
- QwQ-32B quadratic position absorption 未反映。
- confirmed 7-8B 和 exploratory 32B 的区分已有但不够显著。

### Limitations
- 3 点覆盖合适（dataset scope, statistical power, architecture coverage）。
- 缺 BCa small-sample coverage 讨论。

### Appendix
- 内容极其充分（20+ pages，30+ tables）。
- Bug disclosure (M002) 是模范。
- 但主文应自包含关键论据，不应要求 reviewer 读 20 页附录才能评估核心 claims。

### 格式合规
- 页数合规 ✓（正文 8 页，Limitations/Ethics 在 p9）
- Double-blind ✓（Anonymous ARR Submission）
- ACL template ✓
- Limitations ✓
- Ethics Statement ✓
- 注意：enlargethispage 10+11=21 baselineskip 在 page 8 较激进，可能被个别 reviewer 视为 gaming page limit。

---

## ⚠️ 处理协议(强制,逐条执行,禁止简略)

**收到上面的审稿报告后必须按以下顺序处理**:

1. **逐条编号通读**: 把报告里所有问题、修改建议一项一项列出来(R1, R2, R3...),
   即使有的看起来重复或次要也要单独保留 — 不允许漏任何一条。

2. **每条给出详细修复方案**:
   - 补实验: 写明实验配置(baseline / 超参 / seed / dataset / metric) + 预估 GPU 时长
   - 改论文: 写明改哪一节、改写思路、新引用是否需要补
   - 改 framing / 措辞: 写明原文 + 改写后版本
   - 写 rebuttal: 写明论点和支撑证据
   - 拒绝: 写明拒绝理由(reviewer 误读 / 超出 scope / 已有反驳证据)

3. **必须调 `post_to_reviewer` 让 Research Reviewer 补充意见**:
   把完整审稿报告 + 你的逐条初步方案打包发给 Reviewer, 让 ta 独立审视有没有
   遗漏、方案可行性、技术细节是否合理。**这一步不可省** — Reviewer 是你的
   独立审查员, 他对每条审稿意见的判断和你互补。

4. **收到 Reviewer 补充后综合定稿**: 把 reviewer 反馈合并进你的 Action Matrix,
   再安排 Main Agent 执行(补实验 / 改论文)或向用户确认 venue 变更。

5. **同步 Issue Tracker**: Action Matrix 定稿后, 用 `read_local_file` 读
   `projects/{project}/artifacts/review_issues.yaml`, 把本轮处理的 issue 标
   `in_progress`、Reviewer 已确认修复的标 `resolved`, 调 `update_review_issues`
   写回。这是跨轮次的修复追踪 — Continue 模式审稿要靠这个表识别复发问题。

**禁止**:
- 跳过第 3 步直接派 Main Agent
- 把多条审稿意见合并成一条 action
- 对低 priority 意见用"暂不处理"一笔带过而不给出明确理由
- 整体性"已知悉"回复

**建议**：不改。

| SF7 evidence gradient 重新定位 | 结构正确 |
| SF8 Figure 重画 | DDL 不允许 |

以下 R29 concerns 我判断是内部审核过度敏感而非真实审稿人会 care 的：

1. **MF1 conditional inference 升级为 4 轮 recurring**：真实 EMNLP reviewer 在 NLP 安全 track 很少深究 selective inference theory。当前三层防护（Section 3.5 + Discussion + Appendix）已超出该 track 平均水平。
2. **SF2 QwQ "significant" vs "suggestive"**：evidence gradient 的 tier 命名是内部一致性问题，不是审稿人攻击面。
3. **SF4 Discussion 压缩**：8 页限制下 Discussion 压缩是 venue constraint，不是论文质量问题。真实审稿人理解这一点。

### 评分和策略

**R29 = 3.0，R1=3.5, R2=3.5**。Director 降至 3.0 说明内部标准严于 reviewer 给分。如果 R1/R2 都给 3.5，真实 AC 评分可能在 3.25-3.5 区间。

**主要瓶颈不变**：单数据集 + 3/4 Qwen 是结构性天花板，文本编辑无法突破。

**建议策略**：做上述 ~30 min quick fixes，然后**停止迭代**。当前论文状态经过 R24-R28 五轮打磨已经达到了 text-editing 的收益极限。进一步迭代的边际收益趋近于零，且有引入 regression 的风险（每次改动都可能触发新的一致性问题）。把精力转到 rebuttal 准备上——对结构性限制的有力回应比第 6 轮 text tweaking 更有价值。

lines: We report balanced accuracy, precision, pre-CP FPR, coverage, and lead time. We exclude F1 (conflates precision and recall), AUROC (threshold-free, cannot diagnose layer selection bias), and MCC (redundant with BA under balanced priors). Positive classification requires $K{=}5$ consecutive threshold crossings, selected on the R1-8B validation set and held fixed across all models as the value balancing coverage ($\geq$70\%) and safe-trace false positive rate ($\leq$50\%); \cref{tab:k_ablation} confirms that the HS vs.\ text conclusion direction is consistent at $K{=}3$, $5$, and $7$, with coverage and FPR trading off monotonically. Modality comparisons use BCa bootstrap (10{,}000 resamples, resampling traces as clusters: each trace is an independent unit and all its steps are included or excluded together, preserving within-trace dependence)~\citep{efron1993bootstrap,diciccio1996bootstrap} with Holm-Bonferroni step-down (3 metrics $\times$ 4 models $= 12$ tests, $\alpha{=}0.05$); the 4-test framework yields identical conclusions (\cref{app:holm_bonferroni}). For 32B models ($n \leq 20$), the exact permutation test is the primary inference method; BCa confidence intervals are reported for comparability but may have reduced coverage at these sample sizes (BCa assumes approximate pivotality; heavy-tailed score distributions could produce anti-conservative intervals). Within each model, the three metrics are positively correlated, so the correction is stricter than under independence. Control task selectivity~\citep{hewitt2019control} validates genuine structure (\cref{app:control}). $\dagger$ marks sample-limited test sets ($n \leq 20$): R1-32B ($n{=}20$) and QwQ-32B ($n{=}19$).

-\paragraph{Hyperparameter search space and multiple comparisons.} The full exploration spans ${\sim}$5 metrics $\times$ 7 windows $\times$ 28--64 layers $\approx$ 980--2{,}240 configurations per model. However, the effective number of independent tests is far smaller: the five metrics share one confusion matrix (threshold-based metrics are functionally correlated; \cref{app:effective_tests}), and adjacent layers produce near-identical probes. Effect sizes are large (Cohen's $d{=}0.58$--$2.37$; \cref{app:effective_tests}), arguing against fishing artifacts. A two-stage design protects against selection bias: upstream layer/window exploration uses nested CV and split-half validation at 7--8B (\cref{app:nested_cv,app:split_half}); downstream modality tests apply HB to 12 final comparisons. The 32B models lack nested CV (${\sim}$4 traces per fold) and are marked exploratory ($\dagger$). We classify evidence into three tiers (cross-validated, significant, and exploratory), detailed in \cref{sec:experiments}.\looseness=-1
